title: プログラミング総合
subtitle: Comprehensive Programing
educationalGoal: In this course, students aim to solidify their C language programming skills and improve their programming thinking skills through exercises that comprehensively utilize the C language programming skills they have learned.
advice:
This course aims to solidify the C language programming techniques learned so far. At the same time, students will also learn and deepen their understanding of applied grammar through lectures and exercises, such as structures, multi-dimensional arrays, and pointers.
Students will also learn about numerical calculation problems such as differentiation and integration.

The learning items are as follows.
- Review of control structures and functions
- Review of pointers and structures
- Applications of arrays (multi-dimensional arrays, etc.)
- Numerical calculations (differentiation, integration, etc.)

Students will practice using the C language development environment on their PC to deepen their understanding.

requiredKnowledge:
This class assumes that students have already taken "Introduction to Programming," "Programming I," and "Programming II."
Students will practice using their PC and C language development environment.
Students should thoroughly review the C language grammar and how to operate the development environment.

Students generally understand the basic grammar of the C language, control structures, functions, pointers, structures, multi-dimensional arrays, numerical calculation algorithms, etc.
Students can also create basic programs using these.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course aims to solidify the C language programming techniques learned so far. At the same time, students will also learn and deepen their understanding of applied grammar through lectures and exercises, such as structures, multi-dimensional arrays, and pointers.
Students will also learn about numerical calculation problems such as differentiation and integration.

The learning items are as follows.
- Review of control structures and functions
- Review of pointers and structures
- Applications of arrays (multi-dimensional arrays, etc.)
- Numerical calculations (differentiation, integration, etc.)

Students will practice using the C language development environment on their PC to deepen their understanding.
